service.faqs.languages-a: VedicPanditji officially supports Hindi and Sanskrit. All Vedic mantras, stotras, and hawan ahutis are chanted in authentic Sanskrit, while the Katha, Sankalpam, and step-by-step vidhi instructions are explained in fluent Hindi.

service.faqs.materials-a: We bring complete hawan kashtha, pure desi cow ghee, navagraha samidha, kumkum, chandan, kalash items, and sacred dry herbs. You only need to provide household items like fresh flowers, fruits, and milk.
service.faqs.materials-q: What materials (samagri) are provided by VedicPanditji?
service.faqs.muhurat-a: Our senior Acharyas examine your birth Nakshatra, Gotra, and local Panchang sunrise/sunset timings to advise the most auspicious hour.

service.timing-context.griha-pravesh.bes: Auspicious Shubh Muhurat determined from Panchang (Vrishabha, Mithuna, Kanya, Dhanu Lagna)
service.timing-context.griha-pravesh.not: Both husband and wife participate as Yajamans. Auspicious nakshatras like Rohini, Mrigashira, Uttara Phalguni, Chitra, and Anuradha are preferred.
service.timing-context.griha-pravesh.tim: Morning hours during Shukla Paksha before shifting belongings or staying overnight
service.timing-context.havans.best-days: Shukla Paksha mornings, Sundays/Tuesdays for Ganapathi/Navagraha, or festival periods
service.timing-context.havans.notes: Conducted with sacred mango wood and pure herbal hawan samagri to disperse positive spiritual vibrations.
service.timing-context.havans.time: Morning hours (Surya Udaya Kaal) for optimal Agnihotra purification
service.timing-context.pitru-pujas.best-: Pitru Paksha (Mahalaya), Amavasya, or Annual Death Anniversary (Barsi)
service.timing-context.pitru-pujas.notes: Performed with black sesame (Kala Til), Kusha grass, and pure water for ancestral peace and pitru tripti.
service.timing-context.rudrabhishek.best: Mondays, Pradosh Vrat days, Masa Shivratri, Maha Shivratri, or any day in Shravan Maas
service.timing-context.rudrabhishek.note: Lord Shiva is pleased with Abhishek offerings of raw milk, gangajal, honey, belpatra, and sacred bhasma.
service.timing-context.rudrabhishek.time: Morning Brahma Muhurat or Pradosh Kaal (evening)
service.timing-context.satyanarayan.best: Purnima (Full Moon Day), Ekadashi, Sankranti, Thursdays, or Saturdays
service.timing-context.satyanarayan.note: Ideal for celebrating new beginnings, housewarmings, weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, and fulfilling vows (Manokamna).
service.timing-context.satyanarayan.time: Predominantly conducted during evening Pradosh time or auspicious morning hours
service.timing-context.vastu-shanti.best: Shubh Tithi prior to moving or during auspicious solar transits
service.timing-context.vastu-shanti.note: Recommended whenever moving into a new flat/plot, undertaking renovations, or to pacify directional energies.
service.timing-context.vastu-shanti.time: Morning hours during favorable planetary Lagna
